''See also: [[Weeping Dragon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Weeping dragons{{!}}Dragon is one of the four [[Dreadgods]], a class of immensely powerful beings. Unlike its siblings, this entity retains memories of its former life and possesses a sense of superiority and pride. It is often associated with storms, as its presence agitates the [[wind]], [[water]], and lightning, frequently bringing heavy rain or massive storm clouds with it. The [[dragon]] typically resides in the upper atmosphere, resting upon a vast bed of clouds where it often [[dreams]] of its past. In combat, the Weeping dragons{{!}}Dragon utilizes devastating abilities, including a specialized black dragon's breath{{!}}dragon's breath and the ability to command lightning. It can manifest millions of smaller, serpentine spirits made of blue-and-gold Storm madra{{!}}storm madra that act like a swarm to consume the spiritual energy of targets. The entity is also known for its ability to reshape landscapes and cause massive [[destruction]], such as landslides or the drying of rivers. A dedicated cult known as the [[Stormcallers]] follows the Weeping dragons{{!}}Dragon. Members of this sect often utilize [[madra]] derived from the [[dragon]], which carries its animating will and [[hunger]]. They are characterized by their use of lightning-based techniques and may possess distinctive physical marks, such as sparking rings of lightning around their arms. The [[dragon]] has been involved in significant historical conflicts, including a battle that resulted in the death of the [[Monarch]] [[Northstrider]] and a clash that destroyed much of the [[Rosegold continent]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This [[sapphire]] [[dragon]] is miles long and features blue [[scales]] that crackle with lightning. Its presence is marked by dark storm clouds, rain, and blue-and-gold lightning in the sky.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The entity possesses an unbending [[dragon]]'s pride and a fierce, storm-like will. While it can act like a clever, rampaging monster, it also [[dreams]] of the past and fears waking from those [[dreams]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The creature utilizes [[living lightning]] and [[Striker techniques]] that manifest as tiny serpentine [[dragons]] of blue-gold Storm madra{{!}}storm madra. Its strongest offensive power is a black dragon's breath{{!}}dragon's breath involving blue-and-[[yellow madra]] that devours [[aura]] and cannot be defended against, only evaded.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Battle on Rosegold}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Weeping dragons{{!}}Dragon is a battle occurring on the [[Rosegold continent]] involving a clever entity that acts like a rampaging monster.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18">''Waybound'', chapter 18</ref> Gaining strength from the demise of the [[Silent King]] and the [[Slumbering Wraith]], this creature resembles the [[Wandering Titan]] externally but contains the [[Silent King]] within.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" /> This [[Dreadgod]] can dodge predictions by clouding possibilities and carries hidden threads of [[Fate]] behind clouds.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref> The entity possesses an unbending [[dragon]]'s pride and a gaze capable of stripping away hope and crushing spirits.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> Dragging dark clouds wherever it goes, the Weeping dragons{{!}}Dragon thrashes across the landscape like a dying snake while causing storm clouds and rain.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> Its strongest offensive [[technique]] is a breath of blue-and-[[yellow madra]] that devours [[aura]] and cannot be defended against, only evaded.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> During a clash with [[Lindon]], [[Orthos]], and [[Little Blue]], the creature commanded the [[Penance arrow]] away.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> The Weeping dragons{{!}}Dragon's fierce and imposing will causes [[wind]] and lightning storms, especially when its eyes focus on [[Yerin]], whose [[spirit]] can be crushed by its Authority{{!}}authority.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> Despite having killed Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel's friends once before and possessing a claw that trails lightning, the [[Dreadgod]] eventually died.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" />}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon killed Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel's friends once before.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" />}}</li>

</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Defeated Dreadgod}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Weeping dragons{{!}}Dragon was a [[Dreadgod]] that eventually met its defeat in battle.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> During the conflict, it directed its full will toward [[Yerin]] in an intentional attempt to injure her.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /> This entity possessed a [[core binding]] in the form of a golden jewel that measured as long as Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm{{!}}Lindon's arm.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon was a [[Dreadgod]] that was defeated in battle.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon attacked [[Yerin]] with the full force of its will to cause her injuries intentionally.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon's [[core binding]] is a golden jewel as long as Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm{{!}}Lindon's arm.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon has a [[core binding]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Legacy and remnants}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Weeping dragons{{!}}Dragon is a battle that Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss may have sensed, though information regarding it remains limited.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref> It is theoretically possible to develop a method of transportation using the creature's [[madra]], which possesses enough power that an Overlord-level entity can nearly handle a portion of it.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32">''Waybound'', chapter 32</ref> As its breath began to form, the entity was mentioned by [[Lindon]] in relation to Del'rek{{!}}Del’rek's [[Path]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33">''Waybound'', chapter 33</ref> The breath of the Weeping dragons{{!}}Dragon eventually slashed across the face of a moon.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon is a battle Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss may have sensed.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Information on the [[Weeping Dragon]] is limited.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|It is theoretically possible to create a method of transportation from the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon's breath began to form.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon has [[madra]] that an Overlord-level entity can almost handle a portion of.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]] mentions the [[Weeping Dragon]] in relation to Del'rek{{!}}Del’rek's [[Path]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33" />}}</li>

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Tidewalkers]] suffered a devastating blow at the hands of the Weeping dragons{{!}}Dragon.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 1</ref> This entity left a lasting scar across the surface of the moon.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 3</ref> Later, [[Lindon]] was enveloped in a lightning-crackling embrace by the creature's blue [[scales]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref>}}
